who.value: buyer with a home problem, likely new to services on Carousell

job.value: Describe a home problem so the assistant can find the right Carousell sellers

arrivedFrom.value: a Home Assistant entry point in services

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The greeting 'Describe any home problem and I'll find the right Carousell sellers for you' states the purpose outright.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The 'Describe your problem...' field and the 'Tap leaking' / 'AC making noise' chips are the only controls, but they sit at the bottom under a mostly empty screen with low visual weight.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Chips like 'Tap leaking' and 'Pest in kitchen' and the photo icon next to the field predict exactly what gets sent.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Only plain words are used — 'home problem', 'sellers', 'send a photo'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It only asks the person to describe their own problem, which they know, with example chips to start.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Nothing advanced is shown; the header's warning and overflow icons hold anything secondary.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Greeting, example problems and an input are all for someone starting a search for help.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: One two-line greeting and short chips; the person can start typing without reading more.
